chapter_title: The Human is less than all the Things of the Unive
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Kephalaia
 Passages


---


**
¶3**


Not
 only this, but every
 state
 of the
 mind
, from the
 least
 perception
 to the greatest understanding
, exists
 within
 one
 common
 field
 of natural
 knowledge.
 All
 partial
 app
rehensions are gathered
 into that
 general
 field
 and
 are absorbed
 by
 it. Within
 the
 natural mind there
 exist
 many
 elevated
 states of love and worship,
 and these
 are exc
eedingly great in their character
. Yet
 these
 elevated
 states did
 not set
 themselves against
 the Divine
.
 They kept
 silence
;
 they ut
tered no fals
ity
 against the Divine
 Wisdom
 that
 is
 made
 manifest
,
 nor
 against the Divine
 Providence
 that sust
ains all things,
 nor against the Divine Being
 itself
 that reveals
 the
 whole
 of
 spiritual
 reality
,
 nor against the genuine
 goods
 of charity
 and justice
. They attributed
 no origin
 of evil to God
.

---


**¶4**

However
, the fals
ity born
 of self
-intelligence in
 fallen
 humanity —
 that
 fabric
ated
 understanding which resemb
les nothing
 true
 and
 yet
 sets
 itself equal
 to Divine works
 — was
 found
 to be evil before
 the
 Lord
 of
 all. It spoke
 fals
ity
 against the Divine Providence
 that sust
ains all things and
 against the holy
 Wisdom proce
eding from Him
. It profaned His
 glorious Truth
, and
 from
 this
 profanation every
 sin originated
. Those
 who are in
 such
 fals
ity declare
 that every form
 of wickedness and spiritual
 defilement —
 the ruling
 loves
 of
 self
,
 the persu
asions of fals
ity, the c
ravings of the natural
 mind, and
 the invers
ions of all
 good —
 have
 their
 origin in
 God, that He is the one who
 established
 them. But
 these
 ev
ils did
 not proceed
 from Him
.
 Those
 who so
 declare
 bear
 false witness against the Divine.


---

**¶7**


Divine
 Truth did
 not desc
end and
 red
eem the world on
 account
 of the
 human
 mind
 alone.
 It
 came and was
 made
 manifest within
 the natural degree
 of the
 mind
,
 and it was active
 first
 in the vast
 exp
anse of the spiritual
 world beyond
.
 When
 it had completed
 its work
 of
 ordering
 the spiritual
 world in its fullness, it descended
 further
 into
 the states
 represented
 by the earliest
 spiritual humanity and
 revealed itself to them
.

---

**¶8
**


**
First
:** It made
 known to them that they belong,
 in their
 in
most origin
, to the kingdom
 of Divine
 Wisdom.

---


**¶9**

**
Second:** It unveiled
 to them the nature
 of the heav
enly
 degrees
 of
 the Divine
 —
 how they exist
 and
 proceed
 one
 from another
 —
 and it
 taught them concerning
 the nature
 of spiritual
 fals
ity and evil
:
 how these
 too
 have
 real
 existence as
 an
 opposing
 kingdom
.


---

**¶10**


**Third:** It proclaimed to them
 how
 Divine
 Wisdom,
 in
 its fullness and
 power
, has acted
 against the domin
ion of fals
ity and has overcome
 it.

---

**¶
11**

**Fourth:** It taught
 them that the
 Divine descended
 into the very
 province of spiritual
 death —
 that is, into the condition
 of the
 self
hood,
 the prop
rium, which
 is mere flesh —
 so
 that it might rec
laim what
 was lost
,
 and bring those
 who had been wholly
 consumed
 by
 the
 natural
 mind up
 from
 the very
 entrance
 of hell
,
 into which
 they had been swallowed.


---

**¶12**


**Fifth:** Those
 aff
ections and
 persu
asions that
 rebel
 against what
 is good shall
 be bound by
 a great restra
int of
 Divine
 Order
 —
 all
 those ev
ils that rise
 against
 the Good
 itself
.

---

**¶16
**

Divine
 Truth
 in
 its suffering
 —
 which
 perv
ades all things
 and
 gri
eves throughout all of
 creation — is present in every
 state
 that
 is out
wardly manifest
 and in every state that remains
 hidden within
 the inter
iors of the mind
.


---

*
Note
 on
 "
the
 Cross
 of Light"
 (
¶16):
*
 This
 image
 res
ists simple
 one
-to-one correspondence
. My
 best
 reading is that it sign
ifies Divine
 Truth as
 it
 is dispers
ed and
 as
 it suf
fers within
 creation —
 truth
 cruc
ified,
 that
 is, truth
 in
 the state
 of being
 violated
 and griev
ed by
 the
 falsities and
 evils through
 which it must
 pass in
 order to red
eem.
 It
 corresponds
 closely
 to what
 Swedenborg calls
 the
 "Divine
 Human
 glor
ified through
 tem
ptation-
comb
ats
,"
 present
 in all
 things
 visible
 and invisible.
